stem.text: The diagram shows the jib of a crane at an angle of $35^{\circ}$ to the vertical. A cable passes over a frictionless pulley and carries a load of $1830\,\text{N}$.

stem.alt: Crane jib inclined at 35 degrees to the vertical, with a pulley at its upper end. Labels: R, cable, pulley, jib, 35 degrees (two angles), 1830 N.

stem.text: The force $R$ that the pulley exerts on the cable is in line with the jib. The cable and the pulley are in equilibrium.
